name: Google CT Log List
tagline: Google-maintained list of trusted Certificate Transparency logs for TLS tooling.
description: JSON distribution of Google's Certificate Transparency log list, used by browsers and TLS tooling to discover, trust, and monitor CT logs. Served as a static public file from gstatic with no authentication.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public static JSON over HTTPS.

use_cases: fetch the current list of trusted Certificate Transparency logs
discover CT log endpoints and public keys for a TLS monitor
check which logs are usable, qualified, or retired
validate log list schema version for CT client configuration
monitor log list updates for certificate transparency tooling
